questions.prompt: Alice sends Bob 1 BTC and, using the same coin, sends Carol 1 BTC. What is the problem?
questions.right: Yes. The problem isn’t that there are two messages; it’s that both try to spend the same value.
questions.wrong: Not quite. Look at what Alice does with the same value.

questions.prompt: In a traditional digital payment system, who usually keeps the authoritative record?
questions.right: Right. It is easy to coordinate, but everyone relies on that one keeper.
questions.wrong: Not quite. Think back to Maya’s notebook.

questions.prompt: Which of these best describes decentralisation?
options: Participants independently verify against shared rules
questions.right: Yes. It isn’t rule-free; it just has no single controlling authority.
questions.wrong: Not quite. Decentralised does not mean there are no rules.
